competency.instructions: Which language competency does a correct answer in this activity mainly show

criteria.form: Recognizing its written form (characters or pinyin)
criteria.production: Producing it: writing, typing, building or saying it

strength.instructions: How strongly ONE correct answer in this activity proves the learner can do it independently in real use

ambiguous.instructions: A correct answer could easily happen without the skill (guessing, copying a visible guide, or the activity not checking it)

remediation.instructions: After the learner fails this activity several times, what is the best next step

criteria.easier_same_skill: An easier activity on the same skill
criteria.perception_first: Go back to listening and perception before producing
criteria.model_and_retry: Show a model again and retry
